title: The Spring of Harod
text: … camped beside the spring of Harod.

title: Too Many Men
text: You have too many men for Me to deliver Midian into their hands …

title: My Own Hand Has Saved Me
text: … lest Israel glorify themselves over Me, saying, ‘My own hand has saved me.’

title: Fearful and Trembling
text: Whoever is fearful and trembling may turn back and leave Mount Gilead.

title: Twenty-Two Thousand Turned Back
text: So twenty-two thousand of them turned back, but ten thousand remained.

title: I Will Sift Them
text: There are still too many men. Take them down to the water, and I will sift them for you there.

title: Lap or Kneel
text: Separate those who lap the water with their tongues like a dog from those who kneel to drink.

title: Three Hundred Men
text: And the number of those who lapped the water with their hands to their mouths was three hundred men …

title: With Three Hundred I Will Save You
text: With the three hundred men who lapped the water I will save you and deliver the Midianites into your hand.

title: The Others Go Home
text: But all the others are to go home.

title: Get Up and Go Down
text: Get up and go down against the camp, for I have delivered it into your hand.

title: Purah
text: then go down to the camp with your servant Purah and listen to what they are saying.

title: Countless as the Sand
text: … and their camels were as countless as the sand on the seashore.

title: A Loaf of Barley Bread
text: … I saw a loaf of barley bread come tumbling into the Midianite camp.

title: The Sword of Gideon
text: This is nothing less than the sword of Gideon son of Joash, the Israelite.

title: He Bowed in Worship
text: When Gideon heard the dream and its interpretation, he bowed in worship.

title: Delivered into Your Hand
text: Get up, for the LORD has delivered the camp of Midian into your hand.

title: Three Companies
text: And he divided the three hundred men into three companies …

title: A Horn and a Jar
text: … and gave each man a ram’s horn in one hand and a large jar in the other, containing a torch.

title: Watch Me and Do as I Do
text: Watch me and do as I do …

title: For the LORD and for Gideon
text: … and shout, ‘For the LORD and for Gideon!’

title: The Middle Watch
text: Gideon and the hundred men with him reached the outskirts of the camp at the beginning of the middle watch, just after the changing of the guard.

title: They Shattered Their Jars
text: The three companies blew their horns and shattered their jars.

title: Torches in the Left Hand
text: Holding the torches in their left hands and the horns in their right hands …

title: A Sword for the LORD and for Gideon
text: A sword for the LORD and for Gideon!

title: The Whole Army Fled
text: Each Israelite took his position around the camp, and the entire Midianite army fled, crying out as they ran.

title: Swords against One Another
text: And when the three hundred rams’ horns sounded, the LORD set all the men in the camp against one another with their swords.

title: The Men of Israel Pursued
text: Then the men of Israel were called out from Naphtali, Asher, and all Manasseh, and they pursued the Midianites.

title: Rule over Us
text: Rule over us—you and your son and grandson—for you have saved us from the hand of Midian.

title: The LORD Shall Rule over You
text: I will not rule over you, nor will my son. The LORD shall rule over you.

title: Purah the Servant
text: So he went with Purah his servant to the outposts where armed men were guarding the camp.

title: Turn Back
text: Whoever is fearful and trembling may turn back and leave Mount Gilead.

title: Lest Israel Glorify Themselves
text: … lest Israel glorify themselves over Me …

title: The Barley Loaf
text: Behold, I had a dream, | and I saw a loaf of barley bread come tumbling into the Midianite camp.

title: Delivered into His Hand
text: This is nothing less than the sword of Gideon son of Joash, the Israelite.
